evidence.observation: GO3-C3 reads 'applying the original preview after narrowing is refused as any stale preview is', while section 2 GO3 defines narrowing as 'a library function beside candidate_document takes a proposal and its preview and returns the proposal' - a call that writes nothing. In src/gnd/evolve/service.py:2187-2193, apply refuses a stale preview only when the live model sha256 differs from preview.before_model.sha256, so immediately after narrowing the original preview still applies and would publish the full proposal; the refusal holds only once the narrowed proposal has been applied and moved the model bytes.

concerns.recommendation: Reword GO3-C3 to 'applying the original preview after the narrowed proposal has been applied is refused as any stale preview is (stale model CAS)', so a test written from the criterion does not assert a refusal that narrowing alone does not cause.
concerns.title: GO3-C3 claims a stale refusal directly after narrowing, but narrowing writes nothing and the original preview stays applicable

evidence.observation: GO5-C2 requires 'a round that proposes nothing and a round whose proposals all map onto existing elements give different summaries', but section 2 GO5 computes the summary 'from the proposal and its preview'. In src/gnd/evolve/models.py:652 EvolutionProposal declares 'operations: tuple[EvolutionOperation, ...] = Field(min_length=1)', so a round that proposes nothing has no proposal and no preview, and the plan names no input the summary consumes in that case (it never says the host's drops file alone suffices).

concerns.recommendation: State in section 2 GO5, or in the open questions carried into the GO5 spec, what input the summary takes when a round produces no proposal, or redefine the GO5-C2 fixture as a round whose reply maps everything onto existing elements before any proposal is built.
concerns.title: GO5-C2's 'round that proposes nothing' cannot be represented by the proposal-and-preview input the summary is computed from

evidence.observation: GO2-C1 requires 'a proposal of four operations, one of which the candidate validation refuses: the preview names all four, three admitted and one refused with its verdict, exit 3', and section 2 GO2 says 'A refusal that names no element stays a refusal of the whole proposal and the preview says so in one row'. Today that case raises one EvolutionError from _load_model_document before any preview exists (src/gnd/evolve/service.py:294-295, reached through _validated_candidate at :1507-1518), and a preview's verbalization, validation and blast_radius fields (src/gnd/evolve/models.py:1035-1055) are computed from a loadable candidate model; the plan does not say which fields a preview carries when the candidate does not validate. The exit itself is consistent with today (a ModelValidationError cause maps to 3, src/gnd/evolve/cli_service.py:259-268).

concerns.recommendation: Add to section 2 GO2, or to the open questions carried into the GO2 spec, what the preview carries when the candidate does not validate (which fields are omitted or nulled and what preview_sha256 then binds), so GO2-C1's fixture has a specified shape.
concerns.title: GO2 commits to a preview for a candidate that does not validate without saying what that preview carries

evidence.observation: The GO2 lane runs only 'tests/test_go2_operation_outcomes.py tests/test_evolve_additive_policy.py tests/test_evolve_loading.py tests/test_mc3_evolution.py tests/test_unattended_model_growth_acceptance.py', yet section 5 says 'GO2 adds a field and moves the preview's schema version' and the repository holds three more evolve consumers of preview fields that the lane omits: tests/test_evolve_source_document.py (named in GO1's lane one row above), tests/test_evolve_population_check.py and tests/test_evolve_shape_matches.py, which read policy_issues, population_check and shape_matches and staged preview documents. Section 9 only says lanes 'may be widened' at spec time.

concerns.recommendation: Add the three preview-consumer test files to GO2's focused lane, or name them in section 9 as consumers the GO2 spec must read before widening the lane; apply the same check to GO3 if it edits src/gnd/discover/output.py rather than adding a new module.
concerns.title: GO2's focused lane omits existing preview-field consumers that its schema-version move and new field touch

evidence.observation: GO2-C3 requires 'a proposal admitted today has every operation admitted and every other preview field byte-identical, apart from the schema version', and R0.3 says 'GO2 and GO5 add fields; a proposal admitted today has every other field unchanged (D2)'. But preview_sha256 binds the whole preview body - src/gnd/evolve/models.py:1160-1162 computes 'body = self.model_dump(mode="json", exclude={"preview_sha256"})' and compares canonical_sha256(body) with preview_sha256 - so adding operation_outcomes and moving the schema version necessarily changes preview_sha256 and every digest derived from it (staged preview, pending state, record).

concerns.recommendation: Word GO2-C3 and R0.3 to exempt the digests that recompute when a field is added, e.g. 'every field other than operation_outcomes, the schema version and the digests that bind them is unchanged', so the criterion as written is satisfiable.
concerns.title: GO2-C3 and R0.3 cannot hold literally: preview_sha256 rebinds when operation_outcomes is added

evidence.observation: Section 3 states 'VG1 and GO1 share no file' and D6 rests on it ('shares no file with VG1'), but section 3's own homes give GO1 'docs/release-notes.md' and 'dev/components/', and the reviewed-vocabulary-growth plan's section 3 gives VG1 the same two homes, so the phases do share files; the overlap is routine for this project (the VG plan's coordination note has the second branch to merge rebase on release notes). H21's shared-file enumeration likewise omits that VG2, under either ruling, and GO4 both change tests/test_unattended_growth_guidance.py, which GO4's dependency column nevertheless covers by naming VG2.

concerns.recommendation: Correct 'share no file' to 'share only the append-only homes docs/release-notes.md and dev/components/, where the second branch rebases', and name tests/test_unattended_growth_guidance.py in H21's shared-file list so the coordination claim matches the homes tables.
concerns.title: D6 and section 3 claim GO1 and VG1 share no file, but both change docs/release-notes.md and dev/components/

evidence.observation: H20 reads 'no relaxing of proposed and deontic; no check, record, exit code or revalidation step changes', inherited from the issues' 'Not requested' sections. R0.3 itself plans record changes ('GO2 and GO5 add fields'), and GO2 returns a preview with staged evidence for candidates that today raise a whole-proposal EvolutionError and stage no preview at all - a record change H20's plain words forbid - while the exit band stays 3 either way (src/gnd/evolve/cli_service.py:259-268 maps a ModelValidationError cause to 3).

concerns.recommendation: Gloss H20 to R0.2's operative meaning - no check weakened, skipped or removed, and no exit band of an existing refusal moves - so the obligations table does not contradict the R0.3 and D2(a) it sits beside.
concerns.title: H20's 'no record ... changes' contradicts the plan's own R0.3 and GO2 design

summary: Plan r2 read in full and its citations verified at this checkout: H3-H5, H8-H12, H14, H16, H18, H21 and H22 all match (evolve/service.py, evolve/models.py, evolve/cli_service.py, model/_includes.py, model/__init__.py, model/_parsing.py, model_index.py, input_policy.py, discover/output.py, evolve/shapes.py, unattended-growth.md, the reviewed-vocabulary-growth plan and PROJECT.md, whose Proposed order gives VG1, GO1, VG2-VG5, GO2-GO5 exactly as H21 claims). GO1's shared-document cache is safe against every current caller of parse_model_document in gnd evolve: the loader, guards, validators and json_document only walk or build, and include composition clones the root before merging (model/_includes.py _merge), with GO1-C3 as the control for drift; R0.2 holds since all three loads keep their validations and the YAML guard keeps scanning. The phase graph is acyclic and the one-writer order is consistent. The seven concerns below are criterion-wording and lane gaps, none blocking: two criteria cannot pass a test written from their literal words (GO3-C3, GO2-C3's digest clause), one GO5-C2 fixture has no representable input, GO2 leaves the refused-candidate preview shape unstated, GO2's lane omits three existing preview consumers, and two consistency nits in the obligations and coordination claims.
